name: Sasamoto Kouhei
source: During his father's short-term overseas business trip, he is looked after by the Makabe family next door. He is a cultured type who is good at studying, but not very good at sports.
translation: During his father's short-term overseas business trip, he is looked after by the Makabe family next door. He is a cultured type who is good at studying, but not very good at sports.
